name.value: The Conservation Area at Maplewood Flats

description.value: The Conservation Area at Maplewood Flats is the North Shore's only wild bird sanctuary, managed by the Wild Bird Trust of BC on the unceded territory of the Tsleil-Waututh Nation, featuring 5km of trails through restored mudflat habitat along Burrard Inlet. The site includes a Nature House, rotating and permanent exhibits, and a Coast Salish Plant Nursery that weaves ecological conservation with Indigenous cultural heritage. Situated on Dollarton Highway near the Second Narrows Bridge, it offers touring cyclists a distinctive and peaceful detour through one of North Vancouver's most ecologically significant green spaces.
